title: PCSO turns over medical devices to NCSC-NCR
summary: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over mobility aids, medical devices and Charitimba food packs to the National Commission of Senior Citizens-National Capital Region (NCSC-NCR)…

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over mobility aids, medical devices and Charitimba food packs to the National Commission of Senior Citizens-National Capital Region (NCSC-NCR) during a ceremony held on October 6, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. PCSO General Manager Melquiades A. Robles led the turnover of the assistance, which NCSC Commissioner Gloria Mercado formally received. The donation is part of PCSO’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program, which provides support to various sectors and communities, including senior citizens who may need assistance with mobility, healthcare, and basic necessities.
